interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the photon counting histogram, the settings and the outputs.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through loading a file, computing the histogram and fitting it.

interactive.label: Load TTTR
interactive.tooltip: Choose a photon-stream file (PTU, HT3, T2R, T3R, PTO, SPC) to analyse.

interactive.label: Compute PCH
interactive.tooltip: Bin the photons of the loaded file into counting intervals and histogram the counts per bin.

interactive.label: Fit Model
interactive.tooltip: Fit the species model (brightness and occupancy per component) to the histogram over the selected k range.

interactive.label: Save Results
interactive.tooltip: Write the histogram, the fit and the results text as NPZ, CSV and TXT files.
